parameters.name: DeliveryNameLike
parameters.description: The name of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: DeliveryType
parameters.description:
The type of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Valid values:

- **syslog**: Log delivery to a syslog server.

- **kafka**: Log delivery to a Kafka cluster.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** returned in the previous call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.
